# GoHard formatter oracle (#32): force_out, ghdl.
# Written by go run ./tools/oracle --update; do not edit.
# Every file is formatted once with the design's format.* options
# under the standard it is first listed with (variants reuse that
# text). The original and the formatted files of each run are analyzed
# in order, one file per command, in two fresh work directories. Error
# lines of the formatted text are mapped back to the original lines;
# "new" lists errors only the formatted text has, "gone" errors only
# the original has. The check needs "result new=0".
tool ghdl 6.0.0
options indent=2 keyword_case=lower align_ports=true max_line_length=80
run main std=2008
file force_out.vhd std=2008 sha256=e42caceb9fcba96d67eb8f969d1dccc72d3f9643e0851a03726def25a6aa4210 formatted=16dab4651556c7ce0a6f523a9112ed073b9aebde0e6ef994eeece31c01651613 changed
  exit original=0 formatted=0
file force_out_tb.vhd std=2008 sha256=98184ee0469f7cc25672c715a0f23d00e878dc2cd13804ddd131f73c528f014f formatted=cd0f5b0567440f31a21268d74d515a41f10c88641096bf9f9ae97e85fae89c3e changed
  exit original=1 formatted=1
  error 31: unexpected token 'out' in a primary
  error 31: missing ";" at end of statement
  error 44: missing ";" at end of statement
result new=0
